svg.aria-label: A terminal: never4ga init over a folder of notes, index, search, then a context pack for a repository
svg.text: never4ga index -- then `search` reaches these notes
never4ga workspace create <Name> --type <type> -- a Context Pack is scoped to a workspace
never4ga workspace map <workspace-id> --repo <path> -- and a pack reaches it
